```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
ran the table 
```{r}
lead <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(lead))
```


```{r}
ggplot(lead, aes(
  x = year,
  y = metric_value
)) + 
  geom_line(colour = "pink") +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("Number of Cases") +
  ggtitle("Cases by Year of Lead Poisoning")
 
```
